_comment: composer.json constraints for a Shopware 6.7 plugin. The conflict block is not decoration: without it Composer installs the plugin under 6.8 too, where changed signatures fatal on the first page view in production — not at install time. It also forbids writing code for the next major, which is why rector.php never carries the 6.8 set.
_comment_phpunit: phpunit/phpunit is deliberately absent. It comes from the project (../../../vendor/bin/phpunit) together with the core's test behaviours; a second copy in the plugin loads a second autoloader and breaks them with errors that look like test failures.
_comment_allow_plugins: Without this block Composer asks interactively and refuses in a non-interactive run, so phpstan/extension-installer never registers the five extensions and PHPStan reports different errors locally than in CI.
